## New

- **macOS** (13 Ventura or newer, Apple Silicon and Intel): the desktop app now runs on the Mac. Files, clipboard, Shell, Remote, Cast and the USB cable link work as on Linux and Windows, with a menu bar item, notifications with Accept / Decline and Open / Show in Finder, and start at login.
  - The phone camera becomes a webcam through OBS (OBS Virtual Camera); the phone mic through BlackHole, which Setup installs. Steps in the README.
  - Download the .dmg and drag Dotlink to Applications. It isn't signed with an Apple Developer ID yet: the first time, open it from System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway.
- PC: Activity has a Clear button for the transfer history, and the buttons have icons.
- Phone: Clear history for transfers; Remote and Shell open from the PC tab, so the tab bar is shorter.

## Fixes

- Phone: finds the PC again when the PC is on the phone's own hotspot.
- Phone: the tab rail in landscape scrolls on small screens; screen titles are slightly smaller.
- Phone: the PC settings hide as soon as the PC is forgotten.
- PC: text fields match the height of the buttons next to them.
